```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('.qr-trigger').forEach(function (el) {
    var url = el.dataset.qrUrl;
    var encoded = encodeURIComponent(url);
    new bootstrap.Popover(el, {
      trigger: 'click',
      html: true,
      placement: 'left',
      title: 'Scan to open',
      content: '<div style="text-align:center;padding:4px"><img src="https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=180x180&data=' + encoded + '" alt="QR Code" style="border:6px solid white;display:block;margin:0 auto"><small style="color:#6b7280;font-size:0.75rem;word-break:break-all">' + url + '</small></div>'
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('.qr-trigger') && !e.target.closest('.popover')) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.qr-trigger').forEach(function (el) {
        var pop = bootstrap.Popover.getInstance(el);
        if (pop) pop.hide();
      });
    }
  });
});
</script>
```
